claimBoundary.purpose: A product candidate responding to diagnostic failure patterns retained in v2, not to an eligible creator win.

budgetRevision.reason: Exact-HEAD review required quote-aware YAML comments and the then-reviewed metadata.hermes.config vendor surface.
budgetRevision.laterReason: A later exact-HEAD review required optional default_prompt, all-decodable-file local-path scanning, and single-line CommonMark reference-definition destinations.
budgetRevision.holisticReviewReason: A bounded exact-HEAD adversarial audit reduced the custom claim to a canonical ToolboxMD checker, made nested Hermes metadata opt-in, added quote-aware canonical scalar and Codex sidecar checks, exposed Markdown and non-Python-script coverage limits, and optionally invokes an already-installed official skills-ref validator.
budgetRevision.latestExactHeadReviewReason: Exact-HEAD review required YAML special-float classification and dot-relative fragile script-path detection.
budgetRevision.sequenceAndCommandReviewReason: Exact-HEAD review required active sequence-item state for canonical Hermes config and separator-bounded same-line fragile script detection.
budgetRevision.quoteOnlyCanonicalReason: Exact-HEAD review replaced partial implicit-YAML classification with JSON-double-quoted generated strings, mapping-only portable metadata, and parity-aware shell-continuation normalization.
budgetRevision.portableMetadataKeyReason: Exact-HEAD review required JSON-double-quoted user-defined portable metadata keys so YAML cannot implicitly type boolean, date, or numeric-looking keys.
budgetRevision.emptyMetadataReason: Exact-HEAD review required bare and comment-only metadata blocks to fail while omission remains valid.
budgetRevision.directCommandReason: Exact-HEAD review required command-position detection for direct task-relative helpers; the prescribed validator command now treats warnings as errors.
budgetRevision.optionalSidecarAndAssignmentReason: Exact-HEAD review aligned independently optional Codex sidecar sections and replaced library shell tokenization with a bounded readable lexical scanner preserving quote, escape, operator, redirection, comment, command-position, and assignment provenance.
budgetRevision.lexicalScannerCapRevisionReason: The 4,000-byte cap revision preserves readable activated-core doctrine and an executable-only bounded lexical scanner required by exact-HEAD review; activated-core, description, file, reference, eval, and script budgets are unchanged.
budgetRevision.groupingOperatorReason: Exact-HEAD review required unquoted shell grouping parentheses to create command boundaries while quoted and escaped parentheses remain word data; canonical inline Markdown links are masked before command scanning to preserve the existing link-destination false-positive boundary.
budgetRevision.scriptSyntaxAttestationReason: Exact-HEAD review required standalone unquoted shell grouping braces, without treating ordinary brace words as commands, and a no-execution, exact-digest operator attestation that lets separately checked non-Python helpers pass strict validation without claiming ToolboxMD ran their syntax commands.
budgetRevision.syntaxAttestationCapRevisionReason: The 4,000-byte cap revision preserves readable deterministic path, file-type, duplicate, and stale-digest diagnostics. Activated-core, description, file, reference, eval, and script budgets are unchanged, and no extra evidence artifact is required.
budgetRevision.shellControlPrefixReason: Exact-HEAD review required bounded same-line shell clause state for a fixed unquoted control-prefix set, preserving command position without treating quoted, escaped, prose, argument, fi, or done tokens as command boundaries.
budgetRevision.descriptionAngleBracketReason: Exact-HEAD review required built-in host-validator compatibility for descriptions containing angle brackets when the optional skills-ref executable is unavailable.
budgetRevision.closedSurfaceScriptPathReason: A Grok architecture audit and exact-HEAD review replaced the open-ended shell lexer with a closed-surface portability rule for root, blockquote, and list shell fences, single-line inline and other Markdown code contexts, UTF-8 helper sources, and executable or shebang files. A path-bearing child is an immediate non-whitespace lexical child after scripts/; leading-whitespace child names are outside this checker. The executable-only delta includes explicit context diagnostics and does not parse shell or full CommonMark grammar.
budgetRevision.containerFenceLinkMaskingReason: Exact-HEAD review reused the declared root, blockquote, and list fence state for Markdown link masking so missing example links inside those code surfaces do not become package link errors. The real-interpreter shim regression is test-only and does not affect package bytes.
budgetRevision.quotedNameAndScriptLocationReason: Exact-HEAD review removed the remaining unquoted-name exception and rejects executable or shebang helpers outside scripts/. Reusing package collection for the location check and deleting obsolete scalar special cases reduced executable bytes without weakening the canonical fixture matrix.
budgetRevision.listContainerBlankLineReason: Exact-HEAD review required blank lines inside list-contained fences to retain shared script-path and Markdown-link masking state without waiving blockquote markers or nonblank container exits.
budgetRevision.windowsAndCreationModeReason: Exact-HEAD review required case-insensitive Windows drive-user paths and an explicit creation mode that enforces generated sidecar UI fields without rejecting supported partial existing sidecars in general mode.
budgetRevision.remoteLinkAndWhitespaceReason: Independent exact-current audit required remote and anchor Markdown destinations to hide URL query and fragment text from workstation-path scanning while file and drive-root links remain local, and required present sidecar interface strings to contain non-whitespace text.
budgetRevision.parentRelativeAndFileAuthorityReason: Exact-HEAD review required one-or-more parent-relative helper prefixes at the existing lexical token boundary and local file URI authorities with empty or case-insensitive localhost hosts, while embedded parent segments and remote file authorities stay outside those checks.
budgetRevision.unicodeSurrogateReason: Exact-HEAD review required the shared canonical scalar decoder to reject YAML-invalid JSON surrogate escapes across frontmatter, metadata, and sidecars while literal Unicode and escaped backslash text remain valid. Reusing that decoder and deleting redundant runtime annotation and module declarations reduced executable bytes.
budgetRevision.mixedDotAndPythonUtf8Reason: Exact-HEAD review required arbitrary combinations of canonical ./ and ../ helper-path segments at the existing token boundary and required invalid UTF-8 Python helpers to remain package-validation failures instead of escaping through the later AST decode. Reusing the prefix rule and deleting a redundant subprocess default kept the executable delta bounded.
budgetRevision.fileUriCaseReason: Exact-HEAD review required the file URI scheme and localhost authority to be case-insensitive while POSIX root spelling remains case-sensitive and remote authorities remain nonlocal.
budgetRevision.extensionSkipAndSidecarUtf8Reason: Exact-HEAD review required invalid UTF-8 OpenAI sidecars to remain a single package-validation error and required explicit Hermes extension mode to skip the portable skills-ref cross-check before executable discovery or invocation.
budgetRevision.extensionSkipCapRevisionReason: The 1,000-byte package-cap revision preserves readable executable-only UTF-8 and extension-boundary handling after a bounded active-core deletion pass. Activated-core, description, file, reference, eval, and script budgets are unchanged, and no lower total package-size claim is allowed.
budgetRevision.descriptionAndEncodedFileUriReason: Exact-HEAD review required the portable 1,024-character description ceiling to remain invariant when callers raise the package budget and required percent-decoding only lexically bounded empty-authority or localhost file URI paths before case-sensitive workstation-root classification, without treating embedded text, remote authorities, or remote and anchor destinations as local.
budgetRevision.windowsHelperFileUriAndReferenceReason: Exact-HEAD review required slash or backslash task-relative helper separators, decoded local file URI classification for mixed-separator Windows drive-user roots, and indentation-neutral labels for canonical reference definitions.
budgetRevision.singleSlashFileUriDependencyStaticPrefix: Exact-HEAD review required local single-slash file URI roots, non-whitespace MCP dependency values, and static task-relative segment prefixes including embedded dot-normalizing forms. Follow-up audit preserved literal skill-directory and home roots, URI and remote tokens, and ordinary Markdown link destinations, including links in Markdown helper sources. The executable avoids runtime-evaluated PEP 604 optional annotations so system Python 3.9 reaches its CLI. A readable deletion pass removed 87 activated-core bytes without changing its workflow or budgets.

package.aggregateAlgorithm: SHA-256 of lines '<file-sha256>  <relative-path>\n' with entries sorted by bytewise UTF-8 relative path ascending

proves: the frozen product package and exact creator budgets reproduce
the validator runs from outside the package without Python bytecode writes

immediate non-whitespace helper children with bare, leading-dot, or embedded static task-relative segment prefixes using slash or backslash separators fail in root, blockquote, and list closed case-insensitive sh, bash, and shell fences without interpreting commands, strings, comments, heredocs, wrappers, assignments, or continuations

single-line inline code, indented code, and non-shell or unknown fences containing that lexical helper shape fail with a context error, while ordinary prose, Markdown link destinations, directory-only mentions, leading-whitespace child names, literal skill-directory and home roots, and URI tokens remain accepted

all UTF-8 files below scripts/ and executable or shebang files reject leading or embedded static task- and parent-relative helper paths, while ordinary Markdown link destinations and generic configuration files remain outside this policy absent a schema
recognized shell fences must close and the prescribed validator command enables warnings-as-errors
explicit skill-directory script examples pass

the canonical current Codex sidecar subset handles quote-aware comments, duplicate fields, supported and bounded interface strings, assets-only icon paths, optional default_prompt, policy, non-whitespace MCP dependency values, and invalid UTF-8 as one package issue

Codex interface, policy, and dependencies sections are independently optional in general mode; present interface strings require non-whitespace text, and creation mode accepts an absent optional sidecar but requires both UI fields when one is present
valid Markdown links with optional titles pass

single-line CommonMark reference definitions support zero to three leading spaces, angle-bracket destinations, and optional titles while four-space indented code is masked and missing or escaping targets fail
skill names containing reserved provider strings fail
every top-level string, including name, requires one-line JSON double quotes before slug, reserved-name, length, and directory checks

YAML-invalid lone and paired JSON surrogate escapes fail through the shared canonical scalar decoder across top-level fields, portable metadata keys and values, Hermes values, and OpenAI sidecars while literal Unicode scalar values and escaped backslash text remain valid

the quote-only contract rejects plain prose, dates, hexadecimal, octal, collections, booleans, nulls, numbers, special floats, single quotes, block scalars, tags, nested scalar syntax, and invalid quotes without partial implicit-YAML classification
the portable description ceiling is 1,024 characters regardless of a looser package-budget flag, while callers may impose a stricter budget
description angle brackets fail the built-in host-validator compatibility check even when skills-ref is unavailable, while ordinary quoted prose passes

portable metadata uses JSON-double-quoted user-defined keys and values with no sequence markers, while explicit Hermes mode keeps fixed schema fields unquoted and requires double-quoted user-provided values
bare and comment-only metadata blocks fail while omitting optional metadata passes

canonical Markdown links ignore root, blockquote, and list-contained fenced code plus inline, indented, and escaped forms, validate simple destinations, and warn that complex or unresolved forms need official validation
blank lines retain root, blockquote, list, and nested blockquote-list fence state without waiving required blockquote markers or nonblank container exits

common POSIX, container, file URI, and Windows workstation paths are detected, including percent-decoded lexically bounded local single-slash or empty/localhost file URI paths with mixed-separator Windows drive-user roots, case-insensitive file schemes and localhost authorities, shebangs, and direct case-insensitive Windows drive-user roots, while decoded POSIX root spelling stays case-sensitive and embedded file text, remote file authorities, and remote or anchor destinations remain nonlocal

local paths in any UTF-8-decodable package file are detected, likely non-UTF-8 scripts fail, invalid UTF-8 Python remains a single package-validation error before AST parsing, and binary assets are skipped
executable or shebang helpers outside scripts/ fail canonical package policy while outside non-executable data without a shebang remains allowed

Python helper syntax below scripts/ is checked through AST while non-Python helpers there require explicit exact-current-byte operator attestations to pass strict mode; the checker reports accepted paths and does not claim it executed their language-specific commands

portable mode calls an already-installed skills-ref without a shell using exact validate argv and a bounded timeout, with pass, invalid, unexpected, timeout, unavailable, and unattested external-behavior states reported separately; explicit Hermes extension mode reports skipped_extension without discovering or invoking that portable validator
root-relative and remote web links are not misclassified as workstation paths
the real copyable minimal-skill example passes the canonical checker under an explicit package budget
default reference and eval baggage and unconditional Git inspection are absent
the retained meeting-followups and weekly-status-deck path and baggage patterns are detected
retained creator inputs remain byte-identical
doesNotProve: arbitrary YAML or full CommonMark validity
multiline inline code spans or task-relative helper child names whose first character is whitespace
shell command parsing or wrapper, assignment, quoting, comment, heredoc, continuation, and control-flow semantics
execution of language-specific checks or syntax validity of non-Python helper scripts
